text:
XLAT::src_port
Description
This iRules command returns the source translation port.
Syntax
XLAT
::
src_port
Examples
when
SA_PICKED
{
log
local0.
"[XLAT::src_port]"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
SA_PICKED
